overloadPatches.semanticRole: Forces the user to remain in the current data-entry form (if aField is omitted) or in aField specifically (if passed), rejecting an attempt to accept/exit.

constraints: Two behaviors share one optional parameter: called with no argument, it rejects the entire data entry and keeps the user in the form; called with aField, it rejects only that field and keeps the user in it.
Docs recommend considering built-in data validation tools before reaching for this command.
